gemini.rationale: The entity ceased independent public reporting in mid-2019 (roughly 1.5 years post-closing) after being acquired by FIS, meaning there is no independent public record at the 3-5 year horizon. While the FY2018 10-K mentions ongoing integration challenges, the lack of data at the 3-5 year mark makes all pathways and performance metrics uncertain.

grok.performance_metric: acquired by FIS ~18 mo post-close; independent reporting ceased
grok.rationale: The FY2018 10-K only records that integration of departments, systems, business units, operating procedures and IT ‘continue to present certain challenges’ and that synergies might not be realized—generic, prospective risk language, not a documented realized product/process (p4) failure. The same passages do not establish a realized operations-vs-organization fracture (p5); they note ongoing integration spend and unresolved challenges without evidence that process integration broke against people/management/culture. No independent public record exists past mid-2019 (~1.5 years post-close), so neither pathway is documented as a realized 3–5-year disruption.
